mapper.select: SELECT o.id_ AS orderId, o.order_name AS orderName, o.order_type AS orderType, o.order_number AS orderNumber, o.cust_name AS custName, o.order_category AS orderCategory, o.status_ AS status, o.phase_name AS phaseName, o.actors_info AS actorsInfo, o.create_time AS createTime, o.update_time AS updateTime, o.pi_id AS piId, o.business_dep AS businessDep, o.acc_nbr AS accNbr, o.creator_ AS creator, o.area_id AS areaId, area.name_ AS areaName, area.type_ AS areaType, o.info_id AS infoId, c.name_ch AS creatorName, c.name_ AS creatorPhone FROM topp_order o LEFT JOIN sys_area area ON o.area_id = area.id_ LEFT JOIN sys_user c ON o.creator_ = c.id_ WHERE o.id_ = #{orderId}

SELECT his.ID_ AS taskId, his.TASK_DEF_KEY_ AS taskDefKey, his.NAME_ AS taskName, his.START_TIME_ AS startTime, his.END_TIME_ AS endTime, his.DURATION_ AS duration, su.name_ch AS assignee FROM act_hi_taskinst his LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id_ = TRIM(BOTH ',' FROM his.ASSIGNEE_) WHERE his.PROC_INST_ID_ = #{piId} ORDER BY his.START_TIME_ ASC

SELECT id AS infoId, svc_num AS svcNum, cust_name AS custName, contact_man AS contactMan, contact_phone AS contactPhone, developer_name AS developerName, scheme_name AS schemeName, lvl_name AS lvlName, service_name AS serviceName, conn_type AS connType, amount_per_year AS amountPerYear, eff_time AS effTime, exp_time AS expTime, rate_ AS rate, user_addr AS userAddr, exte_flag AS exteFlag, NEW_SCHEME_NAME AS newSchemeName, NEW_CREATE_TIME AS newCreateTime, NEW_EFF_TIME AS newEffTime, NEW_EXP_TIME AS newExpTime, NEW_SCHEME_PERIOD AS newSchemePeriod, NEW_SCHEME_FEE AS newSchemeFee FROM wide_sys_auto_warning WHERE id = #{infoId}

SELECT id_ AS infoId, grp_name AS grpName, grp_code AS grpCode, user_scale AS userScale, warning_type AS warningType, main_order_flow_no AS mainOrderFlowNo FROM ftp_tc_user_cust_warning WHERE id_ = #{infoId}

SELECT w.id AS userId, w.svc_num AS svcNum, w.cust_name AS custName, w.contact_man AS contactMan, w.contact_phone AS contactPhone, w.developer_name AS developerName, w.scheme_name AS schemeName, w.lvl_name AS lvlName, w.service_name AS serviceName, w.conn_type AS connType, w.amount_per_year AS amountPerYear, DATE_FORMAT(w.eff_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS effTime, DATE_FORMAT(w.exp_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS expTime, w.rate_ AS rate, w.user_addr AS userAddr, w.exte_flag AS exteFlag, w.relation_type_name AS relationTypeName, w.NEW_SCHEME_ID AS newSchemeId, w.NEW_SCHEME_NAME AS newSchemeName, DATE_FORMAT(w.NEW_CREATE_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS newCreateTime, DATE_FORMAT(w.NEW_EFF_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS newEffTime, DATE_FORMAT(w.NEW_EXP_TIME, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS newExpTime, w.NEW_SCHEME_PERIOD AS newSchemePeriod, w.NEW_SCHEME_FEE AS newSchemeFee, fw.user_status AS userStatus FROM wide_sys_auto_warning w LEFT JOIN ftp_tc_user_cycle_warning fw ON w.ORDER_FLOW_NO = fw.ORDER_FLOW_NO WHERE w.main_order_flow_no = #{mainOrderFlowNo} ORDER BY w.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
